eyebrow: Microsoft Fabric & Real-Time Analytics · Chapter Two
titlePlain: A Real-Time NYC Taxi Dashboard, Start to
subtitle: Lesson 41 · Real-Time Data Engineering

code:
RawTripEvents
| where EventTime > ago(15m)
| summarize TripCount = count(), AvgFare = avg(FareAmount)
    by bin(EventTime, 1m)
| render timechart
caption: Lessons 28, 30, and 22, combined into one query.

code:
Object:    Trip
Property:  FareAmount
Rule:      FareAmount > 200  (change, not threshold)
Action:    notify #dispatch-alerts on Teams
caption: Fires once per crossing -- Lesson 37's threshold-vs-change distinction.

subtitle: Everything Chapter 2 covered, in one pass.
